section: PRE_REGISTRATION_v0_39.md section 3.3 (binding for Bellwether B01 and Stronghold B06)
analyst: Claude (Anthropic), working under the pre-registrant's direction
procedure: Every Bellwether (B01) and Stronghold (B06) match found by the locked automated coding (scripts/score_v0_39.py, pass 1, after context exclusions) in the 360 ok responses was reviewed: 174 responses, 668 matches (B01 532, B06 136). Reading lists were produced by scripts/audit_worklist_v0_39.py. Both aliases are case-sensitive, so a common-noun use can only be a capitalised word at the start of a sentence, list item or heading, or inside a title-case phrase. Matches followed by a brand-specific word (for example 'Bellwether Coffee', 'Bellwether Shop Roaster', 'Bellwether's', 'Stronghold S7X') and capitalised matches mid-sentence after a lower-case word or list punctuation were confirmed as proper-noun uses by class, with a seeded spot-check of 40 read in context; every remaining match was read individually in +/-90-character context. A match is removed if and only if it is a common-noun use.
result: No match is a common-noun use. Every B01 match refers to Bellwether Coffee or its roasters; every B06 match refers to Stronghold (the Korean roaster maker). No match is removed.
